messages:
Alex: Heads-up: noticed spikes in invoice deltas last night. Traced to finalizer race where token-entitlements were being soft-committed after ledger ack, causing duplicate credit shims. Thinking we should flip order and add a short lease check window. Thoughts?
Maya: Oof, do you have a sample log or repro?
Alex: Pasted the minimal trace:
```
2026-03-15T03:10:11Z TRACE finalizer request_id=abc123 tenant=acme action=soft_commit status=ok
2026-03-15T03:10:11Z INFO  ledger   request_id=abc123 tenant=acme wrote=+120 tokens ack=true
2026-03-15T03:10:11Z WARN  finalizer request_id=abc123 duplicate_detected=true
```
Sam: Instead of strictly flipping order (which risks holding ledger ack longer), what about adding a pre-finalize idempotency key + per-tenant monotonic nonce? That avoids a latency regression and prevents double-apply.
Priya: Per-tenant nonce means another KV hop and could blow up RPS at peak. We could use a small LRU cache + probabilistic bloom filter for a short TTL to catch the common case and fall back to durable check.
Maya: Alternatively, extend the existing watermark guard we use for late arrivals to the finalizer: ignore duplicates within a 2min window keyed by fingerprint. Simpler operationally.
Alex: Cross-region replay is a concern though — watermark is local. We should build a globally-unique fingerprint: `sha256(tenant|request_id|prefix_len)` so it survives retries and shuffles.
Sam: Agreed. Also emit an audit event with a provenance pointer for every finalizer action so the recon tool can stitch things if we drop to pending.
Priya: Fine, but watch compaction: our compact TTL is 7d. Keep the provenance envelope compact (ids only) so rehydration doesn't explode storage.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: rollout scheduled for token-finalizer v2 at 2026-03-16T03:00:00Z UTC, canary=5%, region=us-west-2.
Alex: @Maya @Sam can you pair on a short RFC? I'll mock metrics + fallout sim in k6 and add a small chaos test for replay.
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll start a draft today. I'll include backwards-compat plan + retention/cost impact.
Sam: Also add a safe fallback: if finalizer can't verify idempotency, move charge to a `pending_bucket` and reconcile hourly in batch to avoid immediate double-billing.
Alex: Agreed. I'll add `pending_bucket` to the billing contract and sketch the hourly reconcile job. Thanks everyone.
